steps.content: After cleaning up the battlefield, Hella and Hecate wave at you from the entrance of the V-710.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, it's time for us to get on board.
You freeze upon hearing Hecate call you "Chief." You spin around to look at Stargazer... Her half-smile makes your hair stand on end.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Chief... this doesn't sound like the title of a Quinn businessman.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Let me guess. You're with the DisCity authorities.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Sorry for hiding this from you... I was sent by the authorities to eliminate the desert bandits.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Although I lied about my identity, the promise I made still stands.
Stargazer shakes her head, and pushes you gently from behind.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: No matter who you are, I have already finished your request. Get on board. It's time to part ways.
You turn your head back. Stargazer is back on the Ferotti, riding sidesaddle into the desert sunset, like a painting printed on a tarot card.

You do not want to part with her here... She is powerful yet calm, with a plethora of knowledge about WhiteSands. These are all qualities that are indispensable for eliminating the desert bandits. Moreover, she is a Sinner...
With this in mind, you immediately turn back to walk towards Stargazer.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If I offer to hire you as an advisor for this mission on behalf of the DisCity authorities, will you accept?

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: I have already completed your request.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then... what if I invite you as the MBCC Chief?
You stretch out your hand to her, revealing the power of the shackles in your palm.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I can help you... and I also need you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your wisdom can help me defeat the desert bandits. I promise, I won't let them hurt you.
Stargazer doesn't accept or refuse. She simply flashes a knowing smile.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Lead the way, Chief.
